June 17, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Violich Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Rio Tinto Plc (RIO) by 158.47% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Violich Capital Management Inc bought 11,600 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,920 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $975,000, up from 7,320 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Violich Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Rio Tinto Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $98.43 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.92% or $1.71 during the last trading session, reaching $56.79. About 3.67M shares traded or 40.94% up from the average. Rio Tinto plc (NYSE:RIO) has risen 37.67% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.10% the S&P500.
